subject.title: Fix compaction fallback for OpenAI Responses auth

question: Should automatic compaction be allowed to fall through from an incompatible inherited OpenAI OAuth profile to the next compatible configured API-key profile, while user-selected and unknown-source profiles remain locked?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and fail-closed, but it intentionally changes which stored credential may be used for a request, so the repository's auth ownership must accept the boundary.

options.title: Approve gated fallback
options.body: Accept the inherited-only same-provider credential switch because explicit user and unknown-source profiles remain strict and provider changes discard the profile.

options.title: Require explicit compaction auth
options.body: Keep every forwarded profile strict and require users to configure a compatible compaction model or credential explicitly.

recommendation.title: Approve gated fallback
recommendation.body: Accept the inherited-only same-provider credential switch because explicit user and unknown-source profiles remain strict and provider changes discard the profile.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects him to the canonical resolver and compaction integration, alongside the auth CODEOWNERS team.
